items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I'm three years older than McShann. I was the oldest one in his band.

ctx.x: Now, were you -- in those days, of course, McShann would have been still in his twenties. No, 1916 he says he was born.
Yeah, I'm three years older than McShann. I was the oldest one in his band. He was about -- I'd say like he was McShann really looked younger than he was, and acted it, too, you know.
